title: aster neobiennis
intro: Aster neobiennis, commonly known as White Wood Aster, is a flowering plant species native to North America. It has been used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of White Wood Aster include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
